description_for_human: Search rental property listings across Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Da Nang) with AI vibe matching.
description_for_model: Search rental apartments and houses in Vietnam. Query by city (hcmc, hanoi, danang), budget range in USD, number of rooms, and style/vibe (modern, vintage, rustic, luxury, urban, traditional, contemporary). Returns property details with images, pricing in VND and USD, location, and direct links. No authentication required. Rate limited to 60 requests per minute.
